title: LA Colossal – Vermilion Najeon 05 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Chinese woman in her late 20s, long straight black hair falling over both shoulders, natural face with a soft smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the bench, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body najeon-chilgi body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Deep glossy vermilion lacquer clearly different from skin, inlaid with iridescent mother-of-pearl grapevines and squirrels. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated on a low lacquered bench, leaning back slightly with both hands planted behind her, chest open and belly relaxed forward, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Towering 9-inch caged vermilion lacquer platform stiletto sandals with pearl accents at each junction.
Nails: Extra long almond nails, pearl white.

Background & Lighting: Traditional Korean lacquer craftsman's workshop with finished boxes on shelves, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm window light with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
